Hymn 205: Once in Royal David's City
Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 205 titled "Once in Royal David's City" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Henry J. Gauntlett and the lyrics were written by Cecil Frances Alexander.
